issue.title: Unblock and ship sase 0.19.0: three train defects fixed, a green rehearsal, PR #322 merged, and the release proven on PyPI
issue.description: The release steward reports release PR #322 releasable instead of looping on metadata refresh. The release-please branch passes blocking lint. release.yml's publish and confirm jobs have uv. One rehearse-mode release.yml run on the refreshed release branch meets every acceptance criterion. #322 is merged through a human-approved gate, the steward's train publishes sase 0.19.0, and the published files are verified against the sealed manifest, attested, installable, and registered as SASE artifacts.

payload.entry: train-fixes done. (1) tools/_release_watch_facts.py: pin_changed is now source_pin != master_pin only; dropped the exact_pin != master_core_pin clause and the master_core_pin read; exact_public_core_pin retained for the Rust policy. (2) .github/workflows/publish.yml sync-release-metadata now runs python tools/render_applicability after uv lock and includes docs/overrides/generated/release_announce.html in the diff check and git add. Confirmed on a scratch checkout of origin/release-please--branches--master (manifest 0.19.0, partial stale at v0.18.1) that render_applicability is the only version-bump-stale renderer; other check diffs there were bare-worktree prettier artifacts. (3) .github/workflows/release.yml publish and confirm gained astral-sh/setup-uv@v4 with cache options after checkout. Audit: every other uv-invoking job (build, exercise-legs, confirm-install) already had setup-uv; stash/exercise/qualify jobs use only preinstalled python3/gh/curl. Tests: new FakePrGithub contract cases in tests/_release_watch_facts_contract_cases.py (exact-pin drift -> pin_changed False/stale_head False; source-pin drift -> True; ahead/diverged -> stale_head True) collected by new tests/test_release_watch_pr_context.py, which also proves a drifted-exact-pin snapshot (0.44.2 == core-ensure pick, pin_changed False) reaches releasable with merge proposed-not-executed and no metadata refresh (fails pre-fix: pin_changed True -> waiting/metadata-refresh; old release.yml fails new audit in exactly publish+confirm). Extended tests/test_github_actions_publish.py, added test_release_every_uv_job_installs_uv_first to tests/test_github_actions_release.py, and test_stale_partial_fails_check_until_rerendered to tests/test_render_applicability.py. Docs: two sentences in docs/contribute/release-train.md. just fix clean; sase tool run check 49aa7c2fddd733a0c28391bcd7b6e0ae succeeded; just toobig clean. epic-symbols empty.
